acf.s030_h2:
Axis Istanbul —
a route to Turkish citizenship
acf.s031_p: In Istanbul's central business district, on the European side.
acf.s032_p: A modern apartment complex with the Axis Mall shopping center on its lower floors.
acf.s033_p: Apartments start at US$284,000, while the real estate investment that qualifies for Turkish citizenship starts at US$400,000.
acf.s034_p: You and your family can apply for Turkish citizenship and passports if you meet the program conditions.
acf.s035_p: Turkish citizenship can open a route to the US E-2 treaty investor visa; further US conditions apply, and the outcome depends on your case and on the decision of the US authorities.

acf.s075_p: A transparent pricing policy, with the same price list for buyers inside and outside Türkiye.

acf.s081_p: A preferential legal fee of US$5,000 for investors in Axis projects, as of the date of this update.
acf.s092_p: Please contact IMM Group for the latest construction progress, availability, and project documents at the time of your consultation.
acf.s093_p: Real estate in Türkiye can be more than an income-producing asset and a store of value held in US dollars. Ownership at Axis Istanbul can also open the way to Turkish citizenship for your whole family and, from there, to the US E-2 visa to invest and live in the United States, subject to US requirements.
acf.s096_p: If you own qualifying real estate, you can apply for Turkish citizenship.
acf.s098_p: The application can include your spouse and dependent children under 18, subject to the program rules.
acf.s099_h3: The route to the US E-2 visa
acf.s100_p: Once you hold Turkish citizenship, you can consider the US E-2 visa route if you meet the investment conditions and the separate US requirements.
acf.s101_p: The outcome depends on your case and on the decision of the competent authorities.
acf.s107_li: Visa-free or eVisa access to more than 110 destinations, including Japan, South Korea, Hong Kong, and Singapore.
acf.s111_li: As citizens, the whole family has access to healthcare, education, and the right to work in Türkiye.
acf.s115_li: Türkiye sits between Europe and Asia — a useful base for cross-border trade.
acf.s118_h3: Flexibility over your name when you naturalize
acf.s119_li: You can keep your current name or take a new one in the Turkish alphabet, which some investors find easier in international business.
acf.s122_h3: Direct to citizenship, with straightforward requirements
acf.s124_li: No requirement to live in Türkiye before or after you apply.
acf.s125_li: No declaration of assets is required for the citizenship application.
acf.s126_li: Open to applicants of most nationalities, subject to Turkish law.
acf.s129_h3: No age, education, or language barriers
acf.s131_li: No degree or work experience is required.
acf.s135_h3: Citizenship for life, and flexibility over your property
acf.s136_li: Turkish citizenship is granted for life and does not have to be maintained through further investment; after 3 years you may sell the property and keep your citizenship.
acf.s139_h3: The opportunity to apply for a US E-2 visa
acf.s140_li: Under US rules, an investor who obtained citizenship by investment must show at least 3 years of residence in Türkiye before applying for an E-2 visa. This is a US condition, not a Turkish one.
acf.s141_li: The E-2 is a nonimmigrant visa; it is not a green card or US citizenship.
